name: tokensaver-vscode
description: VS Code extension that manages the TokenSaver.MCP server and registers it as an MCP provider.

commands.title: Run Full Setup (Install DraftModel + TokenSaver, wait for both to be ready, open AI instructions)

tokenSaver.autostart.description: Automatically start the TokenSaver MCP server when the extension activates.

tokenSaver.server.port.description: Port the TokenSaver MCP server listens on.

tokenSaver.server.startTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the server to become reachable after launch.

tokenSaver.server.idleTimeout.description: Stop the server after this many seconds of inactivity. 0 disables idle shutdown.

tokenSaver.dotnet.command.description: The dotnet executable used to launch the TokenSaver.MCP server.

tokenSaver.dotnet.projectPath.description: Absolute path to the TokenSaver.MCP project directory. Defaults to the sibling TokenSaver.MCP folder relative to the extension.

tokenSaver.notifications.level.description: Show only error notifications or all TokenSaver notifications.

tokenSaver.verboseLogging.description: Enable verbose logging in the TokenSaver output channel.

tokenSaver.simpleModelServer.exePath.description: Absolute path to DraftModel.Loader.exe. Defaults to the location where the bundled MSI installs it (Program Files\DraftModel\DraftModel.Loader.exe, see build/wix/DraftModel.Setup).

tokenSaver.mcp.exePath.description: Absolute path to TokenSaver.MCP.exe. Defaults to the location where the bundled MSI installs it (Program Files\TokenSaver\TokenSaver.MCP.exe, see src/Installers/TokenSaver.Setup).

tokenSaver.simpleModelServer.healthUrl.description: Health check URL for DraftModel.Loader. Checked on startup and after any MCP response slower than 30 seconds.

tokenSaver.simpleModelServer.startTimeou.description: Seconds to wait for DraftModel.Loader to become reachable after launch. First run requires downloading base models which can take several minutes.

tokenSaver.autoCodeHelper.enabled.description: Enable CodeHelper auto-workflow: intercepts code-build prompts, requests a skeleton design from the AI, implements what it can, and returns deferred items for the AI to complete.

tokenSaver.autoInstallPrompt.description: On first activation, if the DraftModel/TokenSaver Windows services aren't installed and the bundled MSIs are available, ask once whether to install them (via the bundled MSIs). Disable to never be asked; you can still install manually via the 'TokenSaver: Install TokenSaver MCP' / 'TokenSaver: Install DraftModel as Windows Service' commands.
